source: Depth range over which the ENTRANCE ring (V1) eases open, anchored at the moment the tip enters (depth 0): closed at 0, full at this depth. Gives the entrance INTERMEDIATE states during shallow insertion instead of snapping fully open the instant the tip touches it. Smaller = opens faster (0.15 ~ full when the tip is 15% in); larger = more gradual.
value: 入口环 V1 从关闭到完全张开的深度范围，以尖端进入时的深度 0 为起点。0 时关闭，到达此深度时完全张开，使浅层进入时有中间状态，避免刚接触就完全张开。较小值张开更快，0.15 约表示进入 15% 时完全张开。较大值更渐进。

source: Full-open weight of the ENTRANCE ring (Vagina_1_open) — the dedicated entrance opener at the very bottom (a radial push, not part of the smooth tube). ~66 matches the snug default fit after the ~30% canal widen.
value: 入口环 Vagina_1_open 完全张开时的权重。该环位于最底部，执行独立的径向扩张，不属于平滑通道主体。通道加宽约 30% 后，约 66 对应默认贴合程度。

source: BP visual depth at which the tip sits at the womb mouth (= normalized 1.0). Calibrate so the deepest ring just opens at full insertion.
value: 尖端位于子宫口时 BP 的可视深度，对应归一化 1.0。请校准到完全插入时最深处环刚好张开。

source: Upper clamp on girth->width scaling (actual girth / Reference Girth). Higher lets bigger objects open wider; pairs with Max Ring Weight.
value: 粗细到开口宽度的缩放上限，即实际粗细除以参考粗细的上限。调高可让较大物件产生更宽开口，与最大环权重配合使用。

source: ANTICIPATION: how far AHEAD (normalized depth) every ring reaches full before the penis arrives. 0 = opens exactly at the ring; higher = opens earlier (ahead of entry).
value: 提前量，表示尖端到达某一环前，该环提前完全张开的归一化深度。0 为到达该环时张开，越大则提前越多。

source: Seconds for a ring to open fully — rate-limits opening so it EASES IN instead of snapping. Smaller = snappier; ~0.01 = the old instant behavior.
value: 单个环完全张开所需的秒数，通过限制张开速度形成渐进变化。值越小响应越快，约 0.01 接近旧版瞬间张开的行为。

source: Leading-edge softness in normalized depth. Wider = more gradual opening (like BP); smaller = sharper sequential opening.
value: 张开前沿在归一化深度上的平滑范围。越宽，张开越渐进，接近 BP 的效果。越窄，各环依次张开的变化越明显。

source: The womb treats the penis as WITHDRAWN (closes) when its entry/base marker k_f_dan_entry sits farther than this OFF the womb's canal axis (sideways) — even if BP still aims the tip up into the womb. This catches pulling the penis OUT for a penis whose entry is NOT NodesConstraint-pinned to this womb's vagina: the entry tracks the base, so it swings off-axis on withdrawal (when inserted it sits ~on the canal axis, a few mm off; pulled out it's 60mm+). Being BELOW the mouth ALONG the canal is fine (that's normal insertion) — only sideways distance counts. An NC-pinned entry stays at the vagina (on-axis) so this never closes it. Lower if the womb stays open after you pull out sideways; raise if it closes while still inserted at an angle.
value: 入口或根部标记 k_f_dan_entry 偏离子宫通道轴线的横向距离超过此值时，即使 BP 仍将尖端指向内部，也按退出处理并闭合。适用于入口没有被 NodesConstraints 固定到该角色的情况，根部退出时会偏离轴线。插入时通常只有几毫米偏差，退出时可达 60 mm 以上。沿轴线位于入口下方属于正常情况，仅判断横向距离。若入口由节点约束固定在轴线上，此规则不会触发。侧向退出仍张开可调低，倾斜插入时误闭合可调高。

source: A womb only reacts to a penis whose tip is within this distance of the womb (entrance for the rings/stretch, womb center for the slosh). Fixes every womb in a multi-womb scene reacting to one penis — each pairs with the nearest. Raise if engagement drops out on long strokes; lower if neighboring wombs still cross-react.
value: 仅响应尖端位于此距离内的生殖器模型。环和拉伸使用入口位置，液体晃动使用子宫中心位置。多个子宫模型各自匹配最近的目标，避免全部响应同一个目标。较长移动时匹配中断可调高，邻近模型仍互相干扰时调低。

source: The womb treats the penis as WITHDRAWN (closes) once the tip marker k_f_dan_end is farther than this from the womb's entrance — even if BP still reports depth. This is what lets you pull the tip out via a constraint/sphere on k_f_dan_end and have the womb follow (BP's own depth doesn't fall when you move only the tip). When inserted the tip sits ~0.08-0.13m from the entrance; pulled out it's 0.3m+. Lower it if the womb stays open after you pull out; raise it if it closes while still inserted (very long penis / very off-seated overlay). Only applies when a k_f_dan_end exists.
value: 尖端标记 k_f_dan_end 距子宫入口超过此距离时，即使 BP 仍报告插入深度，也按退出处理并闭合。这样只通过约束或球体移动尖端时也能正确响应，因为 BP 的深度不会随尖端单独移动而下降。插入时尖端通常距入口约 0.08–0.13 m，退出后可达 0.3 m 以上。退出后仍张开可调低，仍插入时误闭合可调高。仅在存在 k_f_dan_end 时生效。

source: When NO BP penis is engaged, also react to the nearest DynamicBoneCollider (e.g. a BP collider you place and size with KKPE on a bottle/toy). The womb opens and displaces from the collider's deeper capsule end (treated as the tip) and its radius (girth), exactly like a penis. READ-ONLY: the collider itself is never modified. source: BP penis radius of the DEFAULT penis. Ring width scales by (actual girth / this), so bigger/deeper penises open wider automatically.

source: BP penis LENGTH (m_baseDanLength) of your DEFAULT penis. womb_displace scales by baseLen/this — a longer / deeper-set penis displaces the womb more (clamped 0.6..2). Set this to the baseLen shown in the WombExpand debug log.

source: Full-open weight of the tube-BODY rings (V2-V4). The canal blendshape was widened ~30% (100 = ~64mm dia max), so ~66 now = ~45mm lumen (snug on the ~43mm default penis); girthScale opens it toward the wider 100 for bigger/deeper objects.

source: Every N frames each module re-checks what it holds on the camera (the game re-enables its own effects on scene load and UI toggles). 0 = only on scene load and camera change.

source: The occlusion lightened by the surface's own interreflections: a bright surface (skin) keeps less of the darkening, a dark one (black cloth) all of it, per colour channel from the surface module's albedo (needs surface on with Base colour on, both on by default; without an albedo nothing changes). Off = the plain occlusion. Applied on the late objects' own pixels too (the albedo copied before the transparents), on screen and in the renders.
value: 按表面自身的间接反射减轻遮蔽。明亮表面（如皮肤）保留较少暗化，深色表面（如黑布）保留全部暗化，逐颜色通道使用表面模块的反照率计算。需要启用表面模块和 Base colour，两者默认开启。没有反照率时效果不变。关闭时使用普通遮蔽。也作用于后绘制物件自身的像素，使用透明物体绘制前复制的反照率，同时适用于屏幕和渲染输出。

source: Geometry only: what an occlusion ray can hit. Shadow = an object that casts no shadow is not seen by the occlusion rays: an object whose renderer casts no shadow in the game (Cast Shadows off: a translucent swimsuit, eyebrows, eye lines, teeth) or whose name is in surface's No AO shadow list does not darken what lies under or around it; it is still shaded itself and the camera ray still walks through it. Behind a see-through garment an object the game did not draw there (its render queue is not below the garment's) is passed over as well. All = every captured triangle occludes.
value: 仅适用于 Geometry，决定遮蔽射线能命中的内容。Shadow 会忽略不投射阴影的物件，包括游戏中关闭 Cast Shadows 的渲染器（如半透明泳装、眉毛、眼线、牙齿），以及名称在表面模块 No AO shadow 列表中的物件。它们不会使下方或周围变暗，但自身仍接受遮蔽，相机射线仍穿过它们。半透明衣物后方若有游戏并未在该位置绘制的物件（渲染队列不低于衣物），也会被略过。All 让所有捕获的三角形参与遮挡。

source: The colour the occlusion darkens towards: black = plain shadow; a dark warm colour keeps creases on skin from going grey.
value: 遮蔽变暗时趋向的颜色。黑色形成普通阴影，较暗的暖色可避免皮肤褶皱发灰。

source: Curve of the occlusion before it darkens the frame (about 2.2 gives a contact-shadow look): 1 = as computed; above 1 = darker mid-occlusion (stronger, wider shading), below 1 = lighter; open stays open, full occlusion stays full.
value: 遮蔽使画面变暗前应用的曲线，约 2.2 可产生接触阴影的观感。1 = 原始计算值，大于 1 = 中等遮蔽更暗、阴影更强更宽，小于 1 = 更亮。无遮挡保持无遮挡，完全遮蔽保持完全遮蔽。

source: Metres from the camera at which the occlusion has faded to half; far backgrounds get none. 300 (the default, the end of the range) = no fade in practice.
value: 遮蔽衰减到一半时距相机的距离，单位为米。远处背景不受遮蔽影响。300 为默认值和范围上限，实际相当于不衰减。

source: Geometry only: how a ray's hit counts. Distance = a hit within Radius counts fully. Falloff = a hit counts 1 / (1 + d^2 / R^2) by its distance - fully at contact, half at Radius (the screen method's own falloff: contact darkens more than distance).
value: 仅适用于 Geometry，决定射线命中如何计入。Distance 将 Radius 内的命中完整计入。Falloff 按距离使用 1 / (1 + d^2 / R^2)，接触处完整计入，在 Radius 处为一半。这与屏幕方法的衰减一致，接触处比远处更暗。

source: The guided filter (depth-aware smoothing of the sample noise): 0 = off, 1 = one pass, 2 = two passes.
value: 引导滤波，用深度信息平滑采样噪声。0 = 关闭，1 = 一遍，2 = 两遍。

source: Cap of the radius on screen, as a share of the frame width: a close object never sends the samples across the whole frame; with few samples a big cap means sparse, noisy occlusion.
value: 屏幕上的半径上限，以画面宽度的比例表示。近处物件的采样范围不会横跨整个画面。采样较少而上限较大时，遮蔽会稀疏并带噪点。

source: Where the Render button's renders take their occlusion from. Screen = the screen-space method on the depth (one surface per pixel, a thickness guess, the screen radius cap). Geometry = ray-traced over the scene's own triangles after skinning and tessellation (taken from the surface module, a ray tree built once per render; occluders off screen and behind others count, no thickness, no cap): every view of the render traces 4 rays per pixel with its own part of the noise sequence, and the still's mean over its samples converges (with depth of field the views first render without it, and each lens view traces its own 4 rays only where that first pass did not see the point); with Soften on, the traced value then goes through the soft filter; the screen method's Filter does not act on it. The scene's exact duplicate faces are dropped before the tracing, the face the game draws kept. A see-through garment's alpha is traced as it is (its alpha thins the rays, the camera ray walks through its layers and each layer is shaded). The picture on screen always takes Screen - but for the window's Preview switch, which shows the Geometry result on screen while the camera stands. Thickness and Max radius act on Screen only. A Geometry render asks for 4 priming renders to take the scene's triangles.
value: 决定 Render 按钮输出的遮蔽来源。Screen 在深度上使用屏幕空间方法，每像素一个表面，假定厚度，并限制屏幕半径。Geometry 对蒙皮和曲面细分后的真实三角形进行光线追踪，几何来自表面模块，每次渲染只建立一次射线树。屏幕外和被其他物体挡住的遮挡物也参与，不使用厚度或半径上限。每个渲染视角每像素追踪 4 条射线，并使用噪声序列的独立部分，静帧对采样求平均后逐渐收敛。开启景深时先渲染无景深视角，每个镜头视角只在首遍未看到的位置另外追踪 4 条射线。开启 Soften 后，对追踪结果应用柔化滤波，屏幕方法的 Filter 不作用于它。追踪前删除完全重复的面，保留游戏实际绘制的面。半透明服装按实际 alpha 追踪，alpha 减少射线贡献，相机射线穿过各层并分别着色。屏幕通常使用 Screen，只有窗口的 Preview 开关会在相机静止时显示 Geometry 结果。Thickness 和 Max radius 仅作用于 Screen。Geometry 渲染需要 4 次预备渲染来获取场景三角形。

source: The Geometry AO on screen (the window's Preview switch): the rays a pixel gathers while the camera stands, then it stops. 32 shows the shadow's shape quickly; 64 and 128 are smoother and take two and four times as long. The Render button's still does not follow it.
value: 屏幕上的 Geometry AO，即窗口的 Preview 开关。相机静止时，每个像素累计指定数量射线后停止。32 可快速显示阴影形状，64 和 128 更平滑，分别耗时约两倍和四倍。Render 按钮的静帧输出不受此值控制。

source: How far around a pixel occluders count, in metres of the scene (measured through the camera's exact projection). Small = creases and contact shadows only, large = whole-body shading (and more samples needed).
value: 计入像素周围遮挡物的距离，以场景米数表示，并按相机的精确投影测量。较小值只产生褶皱和接触阴影，较大值会形成全身明暗，也需要更多采样。

source: Method Geometry only. Softens the shade of a model's own small relief that the rays draw too sharply - the border between nose and mouth, the line in a cleavage: the shade is blurred over a few pixels (the same share of the picture at any size), never across two objects and only along the surface of the pixel itself. The price: thin contact lines get lighter - the creases between fingers lose about a fifth to a third of their depth - and a large render takes a little longer. On is the default; off = the shade as the rays give it. The Screen method has its own Filter.
value: 仅适用于 Geometry。柔化模型自身细小起伏处过于锐利的射线阴影，例如鼻口交界和乳沟线。阴影在几个像素内模糊，任何图像尺寸下占比相同，且不会跨物件，只沿该像素所属表面进行。代价是细接触线变浅，例如指缝阴影深度约减少五分之一至三分之一，大图渲染也会略慢。默认开启，关闭时保留原始射线阴影。Screen 使用自己的 Filter。

source: Amount of the occlusion: 0 = off, 1 = the full computed shade; above 1 the shade is squared.
value: 遮蔽强度。0 = 关闭，1 = 完整计算所得阴影。大于 1 时对阴影应用平方。

source: Bitmask types only: how thick an occluder is assumed behind its visible front, in metres: thin hair strands and fingers occlude only that much behind themselves.
value: 仅适用于 Bitmask 类型。假定遮挡物在可见表面后方的厚度，单位为米。细发丝和手指只会遮挡其后方这段厚度的区域。

source: Bitmask = a visibility bitmask (thin occluders handled by Thickness, highest quality); Smooth = the bitmask with solid-angle weighting (softer); GTAO = horizon-based (high contrast, fast); Horizon = the horizon-based method with solid-angle weighting (softer, the quickest).
value: Bitmask = 可见性位掩码，薄遮挡物由 Thickness 处理，质量最高。Smooth = 带立体角权重的位掩码，效果更柔和。GTAO = 基于地平线的方法，对比度高、速度快。Horizon = 带立体角权重的地平线方法，更柔和且最快。

source: A plain picture over everything (after the transparents, the LUT, bloom and the studio's effects): Occlusion = the raw value the sampling produced, after Strength and Fade, before Contrast (judge the sampling: dots, rings; on a Geometry picture - the Preview's or a render's view - with Soften on it is that value after the soft filter); Shading = what darkens the frame, the same value through Contrast (Colour left out: grey); Normals = the normal the occlusion stands on as a colour; DepthScene = the distance from the camera as a colour scale over the whole scene, dark violet near to light yellow far; it does not follow Fade; DepthFade = the same distance in grey up to the Fade slider: black at the camera, white at the distance Fade and beyond - move Fade and see how far it reaches; Split = the left half of the screen without the occlusion, the right half with it; Ray normals / Ray surface (with Method = Geometry and the Preview on, once the preview shows its mean) = the normal the Geometry rays fan out around as a colour / the pieces the rays start on, their edges drawn. One view at a time across the modules.
value: 覆盖在全部内容之上的诊断画面，位于透明物体、LUT、泛光和工作室效果之后。Occlusion 显示采样原值，已经过 Strength 和 Fade，但尚未应用 Contrast，可用来检查点状和环状噪声。在 Geometry 画面（预览或渲染视图）中开启 Soften 时，显示柔化后的值。Shading 显示实际使画面变暗的值，即再经过 Contrast 的结果，忽略 Colour 并以灰度显示。Normals 将遮蔽使用的法线显示为颜色。DepthScene 将整个场景距相机的距离映射为颜色，从近处深紫到远处浅黄，不跟随 Fade。DepthFade 将同一距离映射为灰度，相机处为黑色，Fade 距离及更远处为白色，移动 Fade 可观察覆盖距离。Split 左半屏关闭遮蔽、右半屏开启。Ray normals / Ray surface 在 Method = Geometry、Preview 开启且已显示平均结果时，分别以颜色显示 Geometry 射线展开所围绕的法线，或显示射线起始的几何面及其边缘。所有模块同一时间只显示一种诊断视图。

source: A colour the glow is multiplied by (white = none).
value: 泛光乘上的颜色，白色表示不染色。

source: 0 = the glow is added plainly; 1 = the glow is scaled by the frame itself, black stays black (a diffusion filter look).
value: 0 = 直接叠加泛光。1 = 按画面自身缩放泛光，黑色保持黑色，类似柔光扩散滤镜。

source: Weight of the coarsest levels (the wide haze).
value: 最粗层级的权重，控制大范围雾状光晕。

source: On: the glow keeps its brightness when Saturation changes (a grey glow at 0 is as bright as the coloured one, not brighter). Off = Saturation scales the colour alone.
value: 开启时，改变 Saturation 会保持泛光亮度，因此 0 时的灰色泛光与彩色泛光一样亮。关闭时，Saturation 只缩放颜色。

source: Limit how bright a pixel can count (Max, relative to the threshold): tames lamps.
value: 限制单个像素计入的最高亮度，Max 相对于阈值设置，用来抑制过亮灯光。

source: Brightness cap above the threshold when Limit is on; at 10 (the default) nothing in this game reaches it, lower it to tame lamps.
value: 开启 Limit 后高于阈值的亮度上限。默认 10 时，本游戏的亮度通常达不到该上限。降低此值可抑制灯光。

source: Weight of the three finest levels (halo close to the highlight).
value: 最细三个层级的权重，控制高光附近的光晕。

source: The pyramid's base width in pixels, so the glow looks the same at every frame size (a bigger still matches the preview). 0 = the camera's size (the glow then shrinks on a bigger frame).
value: 金字塔的基础宽度，单位为像素，使各输出尺寸的泛光观感一致，大图与预览匹配。0 = 使用相机尺寸，此时图像越大，泛光相对越小。

source: The glow's saturation: 0 = a grey glow, 1 = the source's hue.
value: 泛光饱和度。0 = 灰色泛光，1 = 保留源颜色。

source: The glow's size relative to the frame: the pyramid gets log2(min(width, height) x Size) levels; the change is smooth, the widest level fades in between whole steps.
value: 泛光大小，相对于画面尺寸。金字塔层数为 log2(min(width, height) x Size)，变化连续，最宽一层会在整数层数之间逐渐淡入。

source: The width of the threshold's soft edge: 0 = a hard cut, bigger = the glow starts more gently.
value: 阈值软边的宽度。0 = 硬切，越大则泛光出现得越柔和。

source: The glow's amount: 1 = the highlights' energy once; above 1 = a burnt look.
value: 泛光量。1 = 高光能量计入一次，大于 1 会产生过曝灼亮的观感。

source: The brightness (of the brightest channel) above which pixels glow: 0 = everything glows; above 2 nothing but lamps glows.
value: 产生泛光的亮度阈值，以最亮颜色通道衡量。0 = 所有像素都发光，大于 2 时通常只有灯光发光。

source: Highlights or Glow = that picture alone instead of the frame; Split = the left half of the screen without this module, the right half with it. One view at a time across the modules.
value: Highlights 或 Glow 只显示对应结果。Split 左半屏关闭此模块、右半屏开启。所有模块同一时间只显示一种诊断视图。

source: Focus stacking (Point 2 on): a pixel belongs to the plane that blurs it less; this is how softly it is handed over around the depth where both blur it equally, relative to the blur (0.25 = the hand-over runs from one plane blurring 0.6 x the other to 1.67 x; 0.5 = from 0.33 x to 3 x). At the hand-over both planes blur the pixel the same, so the picture shows no step in blur whatever the value (the grain of few samples can differ until they build up); small = crisper, big = more gradual.
value: 焦点堆栈，需开启 Point 2。每个像素归属令其模糊较小的焦平面。此值控制两平面产生相同模糊的深度附近如何柔和交接，相对于模糊量衡量。0.25 表示交接范围从一平面模糊为另一平面的 0.6 倍到 1.67 倍，0.5 表示从 0.33 倍到 3 倍。交接处两平面对像素的模糊相同，因此任何值都不会产生模糊跳变，但少量采样的颗粒在累计完成前可能不同。较小更锐利，较大更渐进。

source: The strength of the depth of field: the lens aperture's radius in millimetres (how far the camera moves over the aperture). 0 = no blur. Bigger = whatever is off the focus plane blurs more, the bokeh discs grow, and the slice that stays sharp gets thinner.
value: 景深强度，即镜头光圈半径，单位为毫米，也就是相机在光圈范围内移动的距离。0 = 无模糊。数值越大，偏离焦平面的部分越模糊，散景光斑越大，清晰区域越薄。

source: Crosshairs at the focus points on the live picture while the window shows this module's card (amber = Point 1, cyan = Point 2; never in a render).
value: 窗口显示此模块卡片时，在实时画面的对焦点处显示十字线。琥珀色为 Point 1，青色为 Point 2，渲染输出中不显示。

source: The focus plane's distance from the camera in metres: the Distance mode; and the fallback of a point with Auto depth on while nothing is under it.
value: 焦平面距相机的距离，单位为米。用于 Distance 模式，也用于开启 Auto depth 而对焦点下方没有物体时的后备距离。

source: What is sharp: Point = the focus point on the screen (the Point 1 button, then a click); Distance = everything at the Distance from the camera; Orbit pivot = the point the studio camera orbits around. Outside Point mode Point 1 is ignored (its button dimmed); Point 2 adds a second sharp object in any mode.
value: 决定清晰区域。Point 使用屏幕对焦点，点击 Point 1 按钮后在画面点选。Distance 使距离相机指定距离处清晰。Orbit pivot 使用工作室相机的环绕中心。Point 模式以外会忽略 Point 1，按钮显示为灰色。Point 2 可在任意模式中增加第二个清晰物件。

source: The main focus point (Point mode): on = it makes a focus plane (Point mode). The window's Point 1 button places it with a click, its x switches it off. With no focus plane at all, the picture gets no depth of field.
value: 主对焦点，仅用于 Point 模式。开启时建立焦平面。点击窗口的 Point 1 按钮后在画面点选位置，点击其 x 可关闭。完全没有焦平面时，画面不应用景深。

source: Point 1's depth: on = measured under the point every frame (the nearest surface of the 5 x 5 pixels around it; nothing there = Distance); off = Point 1 Depth by hand.
value: Point 1 的深度。开启时每帧测量对焦点周围 5 x 5 像素内最近的表面，没有物体时使用 Distance。关闭时手动使用 Point 1 Depth。

source: Point 1's depth by hand, metres from the camera along the view axis (used with Auto depth off): the plane of sharpness passes through the point at this depth.
value: 手动设置 Point 1 深度，沿视轴测量距相机的米数，仅在 Auto depth 关闭时使用。焦平面经过该深度处的对焦点。

source: Metres added to Point 1's depth (auto or by hand): the plane a little closer (negative) or farther (positive) than what was measured (the point landed on the background behind a strand of hair: -0.1 brings it back to the head).
value: 在 Point 1 的自动或手动深度上增加的米数。负值让焦平面靠近，正值让它远离。例如对焦点落在发丝后的背景上时，-0.1 可将它拉回头部。

source: Point 1's horizontal position on the screen (0 = left, 1 = right). Set by the button + a click, or here.
value: Point 1 在屏幕上的水平位置，0 = 左，1 = 右。可点击按钮后在画面设置，也可在这里调整。

source: Point 1's vertical position on the screen (0 = bottom, 1 = top). Set by the button + a click, or here.
value: Point 1 在屏幕上的垂直位置，0 = 下，1 = 上。可点击按钮后在画面设置，也可在这里调整。

source: Tilts Point 1's plane of sharpness around the screen's vertical axis, in degrees (a tilt-shift lens): positive = the right side of the picture focuses farther away than the left, negative the other way. The plane keeps passing through the point. 0 = the plane faces the camera.
value: Point 1 焦平面绕屏幕竖轴的倾斜角度，单位为度，类似移轴镜头。正值让右侧对焦距离比左侧更远，负值相反。平面始终经过对焦点。0 = 平面正对相机。

source: Tilts Point 1's plane of sharpness around the screen's horizontal axis, in degrees: positive = the top of the picture focuses farther away than the bottom (a face from above: the eyes and the mouth both sharp), negative the other way. 0 = no tilt.
value: Point 1 焦平面绕屏幕横轴的倾斜角度，单位为度。正值让上方对焦距离比下方更远，例如俯拍面部时可使眼睛和嘴巴同时清晰。负值相反，0 = 不倾斜。

source: The second focus point = an additional sharp object, in any Mode (focus stacking: the Render button's samples come in pairs, one view per plane, every view split by its depth into the two planes' layers and the nearer layer composited over the farther one; the preview does the same live): on = it makes a focus plane (any mode). The window's Point 2 button places it with a click, its x switches it off. With no focus plane at all, the picture gets no depth of field.
value: 第二对焦点，可在任意模式中增加一个清晰物件。焦点堆栈会让 Render 采样成对出现，每个平面一个视角，每个视角按深度分为两平面的图层，再将近层合成到远层之上。实时预览采用相同方法。开启时建立额外焦平面，点击窗口的 Point 2 按钮后在画面设置，点击其 x 可关闭。完全没有焦平面时，画面不应用景深。

source: Point 2's depth: on = measured under the point every frame (the nearest surface of the 5 x 5 pixels around it; nothing there = Distance); off = Point 2 Depth by hand.
value: Point 2 的深度。开启时每帧测量对焦点周围 5 x 5 像素内最近的表面，没有物体时使用 Distance。关闭时手动使用 Point 2 Depth。

source: Point 2's depth by hand, metres from the camera along the view axis (used with Auto depth off): the plane of sharpness passes through the point at this depth.
value: 手动设置 Point 2 深度，沿视轴测量距相机的米数，仅在 Auto depth 关闭时使用。焦平面经过该深度处的对焦点。

source: Metres added to Point 2's depth (auto or by hand): the plane a little closer (negative) or farther (positive) than what was measured (the point landed on the background behind a strand of hair: -0.1 brings it back to the head).
value: 在 Point 2 的自动或手动深度上增加的米数。负值让焦平面靠近，正值让它远离。例如对焦点落在发丝后的背景上时，-0.1 可将它拉回头部。

source: Point 2's horizontal position on the screen (0 = left, 1 = right). Set by the button + a click, or here.
value: Point 2 在屏幕上的水平位置，0 = 左，1 = 右。可点击按钮后在画面设置，也可在这里调整。

source: Point 2's vertical position on the screen (0 = bottom, 1 = top). Set by the button + a click, or here.
value: Point 2 在屏幕上的垂直位置，0 = 下，1 = 上。可点击按钮后在画面设置，也可在这里调整。

source: Tilts Point 2's plane of sharpness around the screen's vertical axis, in degrees (a tilt-shift lens): positive = the right side of the picture focuses farther away than the left, negative the other way. The plane keeps passing through the point. 0 = the plane faces the camera.
value: Point 2 焦平面绕屏幕竖轴的倾斜角度，单位为度，类似移轴镜头。正值让右侧对焦距离比左侧更远，负值相反。平面始终经过对焦点。0 = 平面正对相机。

source: Tilts Point 2's plane of sharpness around the screen's horizontal axis, in degrees: positive = the top of the picture focuses farther away than the bottom (a face from above: the eyes and the mouth both sharp), negative the other way. 0 = no tilt.
value: Point 2 焦平面绕屏幕横轴的倾斜角度，单位为度。正值让上方对焦距离比下方更远，例如俯拍面部时可使眼睛和嘴巴同时清晰。负值相反，0 = 不倾斜。

source: Frames the live focus takes to follow a change (a point on an edge: cheek, then background). 0 = at once. The Render button always takes the exact value.
value: 实时对焦跟随变化所用的帧数，例如对焦点位于边缘时从脸颊切到背景。0 = 立即跟随。Render 按钮始终使用精确值。

source: Focus map: the live frame tinted by the blur the Render button would give (green = sharp, under 1 px of the render; orange = blurred in front of the nearest focus plane; blue = behind; a white line on each plane). Peaking: the picture as it is, with the edges and creases that lie inside a sharp zone drawn in yellow (a camera's focus peaking: what lights up will be sharp in the render; found on the camera's depth, so a flat texture does not light up). With the Settings switch Render view on, a Render still carries the view laid once over the finished picture. One view at a time across the modules.
value: Focus map 将实时画面按 Render 输出将产生的模糊程度染色。绿色表示清晰，模糊小于输出的 1 像素。橙色表示最近焦平面前方的模糊，蓝色表示后方，每个焦平面都有白线。Peaking 保留原画面，以黄色标出清晰区内的边缘和褶皱，类似相机的峰值对焦，亮起部分将在输出中清晰。该结果基于相机深度，因此平面纹理不会亮起。开启 Settings 中的 Render view 后，静帧也会在最终图像上叠加一次诊断视图。所有模块同一时间只显示一种诊断视图。

source: Turns the aqua colours towards the previous band's hue (-100 = that band's own hue, 60 degrees) or the next band's (+100 = 60 degrees): a band never passes its neighbour. The neighbouring bands share the change at their edges; it shrinks with the colour's chroma (pale colours get less), greys never move.
value: 使青色向前一色带的色相偏转，-100 到达该色带的色相，偏转 60 度，或向后一色带偏转，+100 为 60 度。色带不会越过相邻色带，边缘处由相邻色带共同分担变化。变化随色度减弱，浅淡颜色受影响较少，灰色不变。

source: The aqua colours lighter (+, towards white) or darker (-).
value: 使青色变亮（正值，趋向白色）或变暗（负值）。

source: The aqua colours more or less saturated: -100 = grey (pale colours get less of the change), +100 = twice the chroma; the push slows down near the most saturated colour the screen can show.
value: 调整青色的饱和度。-100 = 灰色，浅淡颜色变化较少。+100 = 色度翻倍。接近屏幕可显示的最大饱和颜色时，增强速度减慢。

source: Where the shadows tint ends and the highlights tint begins: -100 = almost everything counts as shadows, +100 = as highlights.
value: 阴影染色结束和高光染色开始的位置。-100 = 几乎全部归入阴影，+100 = 几乎全部归入高光。

source: Off: the Basic group is left out of the bake (its settings stay as they are, for a quick before / after); the window's switch on the group's head.
value: 关闭时，烘焙会略过 Basic 分组，保留原设置以便快速进行前后对比。对应窗口中分组标题处的开关。

source: The darkest point of the tone curve: + lifts black to a dark grey, fading out towards white (the faded film look: dark colours go greyer), - flattens the start so the darks sink towards black (black itself stays black). The other four points keep the hue, and the saturation where the colour can still get brighter.
value: 色调曲线最暗端。正值将黑色抬升到深灰，并向白色端逐渐减弱，形成褪色胶片观感，深色会更灰。负值压平曲线起始处，使暗部趋近黑色，纯黑保持黑色。其余四个点保留色相，并在颜色仍有提亮余地时保留饱和度。

source: The silvery, low-colour, high-contrast film look (the frame overlaid with its own brightness): 0 = off, 100 = full.
value: 银色、低彩度、高对比度的胶片观感，即将画面自身的亮度叠加到画面上。0 = 关闭，100 = 完整效果。

source: How softly the two tints meet: 0 = a sharp border, 100 = a wide overlap.
value: 两种染色衔接的柔和程度。0 = 清晰分界，100 = 宽范围重叠。

source: The bright part of the blue colours turns towards the next hue (+, the same way as the HSL hue sliders) or the previous one (-): -100 = 90 degrees, +100 = 90 the other way. On red, + sends fire from red to orange to yellow and brings a pink highlight back towards red. Darker parts of the colour stay (see Highlight start); greys never move. Lit skin is a bright red / orange too: raise Highlight start to keep it out.
value: 使蓝色的明亮部分向下一色相偏转（正值，方向与 HSL 色相滑块一致）或向上一色相偏转（负值）。-100 为 90 度，+100 向相反方向偏转 90 度。例如对红色使用正值，会让火焰从红到橙再到黄，也会将粉红高光拉回红色。较暗部分保持原色，见 Highlight start，灰色不变。受光皮肤也是明亮红／橙色，调高 Highlight start 可将其排除。

source: Turns the blue colours towards the previous band's hue (-100 = that band's own hue, 60 degrees) or the next band's (+100 = 30 degrees): a band never passes its neighbour. The neighbouring bands share the change at their edges; it shrinks with the colour's chroma (pale colours get less), greys never move.
value: 使蓝色向前一色带的色相偏转，-100 到达该色带的色相，偏转 60 度，或向后一色带偏转，+100 为 30 度。色带不会越过相邻色带，边缘处由相邻色带共同分担变化。变化随色度减弱，浅淡颜色受影响较少，灰色不变。

source: The blue colours lighter (+, towards white) or darker (-).
value: 使蓝色变亮（正值，趋向白色）或变暗（负值）。

source: The blue colours more or less saturated: -100 = grey (pale colours get less of the change), +100 = twice the chroma; the push slows down near the most saturated colour the screen can show.
value: 调整蓝色的饱和度。-100 = 灰色，浅淡颜色变化较少。+100 = 色度翻倍。接近屏幕可显示的最大饱和颜色时，增强速度减慢。

source: Brightness in stops after the tone map (the tone map's Exposure works before it): +1 = twice as bright (clips at white), -1 = half.
value: 色调映射之后的亮度，以曝光挡数表示。色调映射的 Exposure 则在映射前生效。+1 = 亮度翻倍并在白色处截断，-1 = 减半。

source: Saturated colours get deeper and darker like film dye or paint (+), or lighter and pastel (-); greys, white and black stay as they are.
value: 正值使饱和颜色像胶片染料或颜料一样更深更暗，负值使其更亮、更柔和。灰色、白色和黑色保持不变。

source: Off: the Colour mixer group is left out of the bake (its settings stay as they are, for a quick before / after); the window's switch on the group's head.
value: 关闭时，烘焙会略过 Colour mixer 分组，保留原设置以便快速进行前后对比。对应窗口中分组标题处的开关。

source: Contrast around mid grey on the brightness only (colours keep their hue and saturation, skin does not turn orange): +100 = twice the slope, -100 = half.
value: 仅对亮度应用以中灰为中心的对比度，颜色保留色相和饱和度，皮肤不会变橙。+100 = 斜率翻倍，-100 = 减半。

source: The point curve on the brightness (the window's Tone curve graph in Points mode): 2 to 10 points "x,y x,y ..." on the 0..1 scale of the encoded value, x rising, the first at x 0 and the last at x 1; a monotone curve through them; the colour follows by the ratio like the Tone curve's five sliders (which apply as well). "0,0 1,1" = nothing.
value: 亮度点曲线，对应窗口 Tone curve 图的 Points 模式。使用 2 到 10 个点，格式为“x,y x,y ...”，表示编码值 0..1 范围内的坐标。x 递增，首点 x 为 0、末点 x 为 1，并用单调曲线穿过各点。颜色按比例跟随，与 Tone curve 的五个滑块一致，这些滑块也同时生效。“0,0 1,1”表示不调整。

source: The point curve on the blue channel alone (Points mode, the B square).
value: 只作用于蓝通道的点曲线，位于 Points 模式的 B 方块。

source: The point curve on the green channel alone (Points mode, the G square).
value: 只作用于绿通道的点曲线，位于 Points 模式的 G 方块。

source: The point curve on the red channel alone (Points mode, the R square): the same text as Curve points; a channel curve changes the colour balance by design.
value: 只作用于红通道的点曲线，位于 Points 模式的 R 方块。文本格式与 Curve points 相同，通道曲线会改变色彩平衡。

source: A colour the whole picture is multiplied by, like a coloured gel on the lens: white = none; a warm or cool filter for the mood, black line art stays black.
value: 乘到整幅画面上的颜色，类似镜头前的彩色滤片。白色表示不染色，可用暖色或冷色营造气氛，黑色线稿保持黑色。

source: The bright part of the green colours turns towards the next hue (+, the same way as the HSL hue sliders) or the previous one (-): -100 = 90 degrees, +100 = 90 the other way. On red, + sends fire from red to orange to yellow and brings a pink highlight back towards red. Darker parts of the colour stay (see Highlight start); greys never move. Lit skin is a bright red / orange too: raise Highlight start to keep it out.
value: 使绿色的明亮部分向下一色相偏转（正值，方向与 HSL 色相滑块一致）或向上一色相偏转（负值）。-100 为 90 度，+100 向相反方向偏转 90 度。例如对红色使用正值，会让火焰从红到橙再到黄，也会将粉红高光拉回红色。较暗部分保持原色，见 Highlight start，灰色不变。受光皮肤也是明亮红／橙色，调高 Highlight start 可将其排除。

source: Turns the green colours towards the previous band's hue (-100 = that band's own hue, 60 degrees) or the next band's (+100 = 60 degrees): a band never passes its neighbour. The neighbouring bands share the change at their edges; it shrinks with the colour's chroma (pale colours get less), greys never move.
value: 使绿色向前一色带的色相偏转，-100 到达该色带的色相，偏转 60 度，或向后一色带偏转，+100 为 60 度。色带不会越过相邻色带，边缘处由相邻色带共同分担变化。变化随色度减弱，浅淡颜色受影响较少，灰色不变。

source: The green colours lighter (+, towards white) or darker (-).
value: 使绿色变亮（正值，趋向白色）或变暗（负值）。

source: The green colours more or less saturated: -100 = grey (pale colours get less of the change), +100 = twice the chroma; the push slows down near the most saturated colour the screen can show.
value: 调整绿色的饱和度。-100 = 灰色，浅淡颜色变化较少。+100 = 色度翻倍。接近屏幕可显示的最大饱和颜色时，增强速度减慢。

source: Off: the Highlight hue group is left out of the bake (its settings stay as they are, for a quick before / after); the window's switch on the group's head.
value: 关闭时，烘焙会略过 Highlight hue 分组，保留原设置以便快速进行前后对比。对应窗口中分组标题处的开关。

source: From which lightness the highlight hue turn starts: 0 = from the middle (a vivid red already counts), 50 = light skin and brighter, 100 = only the very brightest; the turn grows to its full size over the next quarter of the lightness scale (less near white).
value: 高光色相偏转开始的明度。0 = 从中部开始，鲜艳红色已会计入。50 = 较亮皮肤及以上，100 = 仅最亮部分。偏转在接下来四分之一明度范围内逐步达到最大，靠近白色时范围缩短。

source: The highlights of the tone curve (three quarters up: lit skin, bright clothes) lighter (+) or darker (-); the hue is kept; a vivid colour stops where a channel reaches white.
value: 调整色调曲线的高光区，即四分之三处，如受光皮肤和明亮衣服。正值提亮，负值压暗，保留色相。鲜艳颜色在某个通道达到白色时停止提亮。

source: Gain: the brights lighter (+, clips at white) or darker (-, white comes down to a light grey); the hue kept. +-100 = x1.41 / x0.71 on the brightness.
value: Gain 使亮部变亮或变暗，保留色相。正值在白色处截断，负值使白色降为浅灰。+100 对亮度乘以 1.41，-100 乘以 0.71。

source: Saturation of the highlights only (by lightness, with soft borders to the next zone; lit skin and bright clothes count as highlights, shaded skin as midtones): -100 = grey, +100 = twice the chroma; the push slows down near the most saturated colour the screen can show; greys never move.
value: 仅调整高光的饱和度，按明度划分并柔和衔接相邻区域。受光皮肤和明亮衣服属于高光，阴影中的皮肤属于中间调。-100 = 灰色，+100 = 色度翻倍。接近屏幕可显示的最大饱和颜色时，增强速度减慢，灰色不变。

source: A colour added to the bright part of the picture (white or grey = none); the brightness is kept, pure white stays white.
value: 给画面亮部添加的颜色，白色或灰色表示无染色。保留亮度，纯白保持白色。

source: On: the filter keeps the picture's brightness (a mid grey stays as bright), and the brightness of the picked colour is the strength: black = no filter, a dark red = a weak red, a bright red = the full one. Off: a plain multiply (a dark colour darkens).
value: 开启时，滤色保持画面亮度，中灰亮度不变，所选颜色的亮度决定强度。黑色 = 无滤色，深红 = 较弱红色，亮红 = 完整红色。关闭时直接相乘，深色会使画面变暗。

source: Turns the magenta colours towards the previous band's hue (-100 = that band's own hue, 30 degrees) or the next band's (+100 = 60 degrees): a band never passes its neighbour. The neighbouring bands share the change at their edges; it shrinks with the colour's chroma (pale colours get less), greys never move.
value: 使品红色向前一色带的色相偏转，-100 到达该色带的色相，偏转 30 度，或向后一色带偏转，+100 为 60 度。色带不会越过相邻色带，边缘处由相邻色带共同分担变化。变化随色度减弱，浅淡颜色受影响较少，灰色不变。

source: The magenta colours lighter (+, towards white) or darker (-).
value: 使品红色变亮（正值，趋向白色）或变暗（负值）。

source: The magenta colours more or less saturated: -100 = grey (pale colours get less of the change), +100 = twice the chroma; the push slows down near the most saturated colour the screen can show.
value: 调整品红色的饱和度。-100 = 灰色，浅淡颜色变化较少。+100 = 色度翻倍。接近屏幕可显示的最大饱和颜色时，增强速度减慢。

source: Saturation of the mid-saturated colours only (HSV saturation around a half, soft borders to the pale and the vivid ranges): -100 = grey, +100 = twice the chroma; greys never move.
value: 仅调整中等饱和颜色，即 HSV 饱和度约为一半，并柔和衔接浅淡和鲜艳区域。-100 = 灰色，+100 = 色度翻倍，灰色不变。

source: The midtones of the tone curve (the middle of the scale: mid greys, shaded skin; lit skin sits higher, under Highlights) lighter (+) or darker (-); +100 = an eighth of the scale; the hue is kept.
value: 调整色调曲线的中间调，即标尺中部，如中灰和阴影中的皮肤。受光皮肤更亮，属于 Highlights。正值提亮，负值压暗。+100 相当于标尺的八分之一，保留色相。

source: Gamma: the middle brightness lighter (+) or darker (-) with black and white in place; the hue kept. +-100 = a power of 0.71 / 1.41 on the brightness.
value: Gamma 使中间亮度变亮或变暗，保持黑白端点和色相。+100 对亮度应用 0.71 次幂，-100 应用 1.41 次幂。

source: Saturation of the midtones only (by lightness, with soft borders to the next zone; lit skin and bright clothes count as highlights, shaded skin as midtones): -100 = grey, +100 = twice the chroma; the push slows down near the most saturated colour the screen can show; greys never move.
value: 仅调整中间调的饱和度，按明度划分并柔和衔接相邻区域。受光皮肤和明亮衣服属于高光，阴影中的皮肤属于中间调。-100 = 灰色，+100 = 色度翻倍。接近屏幕可显示的最大饱和颜色时，增强速度减慢，灰色不变。

source: A colour added to the middle brightness of the picture (mid greys, shaded skin; lit skin is above it), on top of the two tints around it (white or grey = none); strongest at the border Balance sets, as wide as Blending (never narrower than 0.15 of the lightness scale either side); the brightness is kept.
value: 叠加在两侧染色之上的中间亮度染色，作用于中灰和阴影中的皮肤，受光皮肤位于更高亮度。白色或灰色表示无染色。在 Balance 指定的分界处最强，宽度由 Blending 控制，两侧各不窄于明度标尺的 0.15，并保留亮度。

source: Turns the orange colours towards the previous band's hue (-100 = that band's own hue, 30 degrees) or the next band's (+100 = 30 degrees): a band never passes its neighbour. The neighbouring bands share the change at their edges; it shrinks with the colour's chroma (pale colours get less), greys never move.
value: 使橙色向前一色带的色相偏转，-100 到达该色带的色相，偏转 30 度，或向后一色带偏转，+100 为 30 度。色带不会越过相邻色带，边缘处由相邻色带共同分担变化。变化随色度减弱，浅淡颜色受影响较少，灰色不变。

source: The orange colours lighter (+, towards white) or darker (-).
value: 使橙色变亮（正值，趋向白色）或变暗（负值）。

source: The orange colours more or less saturated: -100 = grey (pale colours get less of the change), +100 = twice the chroma; the push slows down near the most saturated colour the screen can show.
value: 调整橙色的饱和度。-100 = 灰色，浅淡颜色变化较少。+100 = 色度翻倍。接近屏幕可显示的最大饱和颜色时，增强速度减慢。

source: Saturation of the pale colours only (HSV saturation under about a third: pastel skin, light sky, faded cloth): -100 = grey, +100 = twice the chroma; soft borders to the mid range, the push slows down near the most saturated colour the screen can show; greys never move.
value: 仅调整浅淡颜色的饱和度，即 HSV 饱和度约低于三分之一，例如淡色皮肤、浅天空和褪色布料。-100 = 灰色，+100 = 色度翻倍，与中饱和区域柔和衔接。接近屏幕可显示的最大饱和颜色时，增强速度减慢，灰色不变。

source: Turns the purple colours towards the previous band's hue (-100 = that band's own hue, 30 degrees) or the next band's (+100 = 30 degrees): a band never passes its neighbour. The neighbouring bands share the change at their edges; it shrinks with the colour's chroma (pale colours get less), greys never move.
value: 使紫色向前一色带的色相偏转，-100 到达该色带的色相，偏转 30 度，或向后一色带偏转，+100 为 30 度。色带不会越过相邻色带，边缘处由相邻色带共同分担变化。变化随色度减弱，浅淡颜色受影响较少，灰色不变。

source: The purple colours lighter (+, towards white) or darker (-).
value: 使紫色变亮（正值，趋向白色）或变暗（负值）。

source: The purple colours more or less saturated: -100 = grey (pale colours get less of the change), +100 = twice the chroma; the push slows down near the most saturated colour the screen can show.
value: 调整紫色的饱和度。-100 = 灰色，浅淡颜色变化较少。+100 = 色度翻倍。接近屏幕可显示的最大饱和颜色时，增强速度减慢。

source: The bright part of the red colours turns towards the next hue (+, the same way as the HSL hue sliders) or the previous one (-): -100 = 90 degrees, +100 = 90 the other way. On red, + sends fire from red to orange to yellow and brings a pink highlight back towards red. Darker parts of the colour stay (see Highlight start); greys never move. Lit skin is a bright red / orange too: raise Highlight start to keep it out.
value: 使红色的明亮部分向下一色相偏转（正值，方向与 HSL 色相滑块一致）或向上一色相偏转（负值）。-100 为 90 度，+100 向相反方向偏转 90 度。例如对红色使用正值，会让火焰从红到橙再到黄，也会将粉红高光拉回红色。较暗部分保持原色，见 Highlight start，灰色不变。受光皮肤也是明亮红／橙色，调高 Highlight start 可将其排除。

source: Turns the red colours towards the previous band's hue (-100 = that band's own hue, 60 degrees) or the next band's (+100 = 30 degrees): a band never passes its neighbour. The neighbouring bands share the change at their edges; it shrinks with the colour's chroma (pale colours get less), greys never move.
value: 使红色向前一色带的色相偏转，-100 到达该色带的色相，偏转 60 度，或向后一色带偏转，+100 为 30 度。色带不会越过相邻色带，边缘处由相邻色带共同分担变化。变化随色度减弱，浅淡颜色受影响较少，灰色不变。

source: The red colours lighter (+, towards white) or darker (-).
value: 使红色变亮（正值，趋向白色）或变暗（负值）。

source: The red colours more or less saturated: -100 = grey (pale colours get less of the change), +100 = twice the chroma; the push slows down near the most saturated colour the screen can show.
value: 调整红色的饱和度。-100 = 灰色，浅淡颜色变化较少。+100 = 色度翻倍。接近屏幕可显示的最大饱和颜色时，增强速度减慢。

source: All colours more or less saturated: -100 = grey, +100 = twice the chroma; the push slows down near the most saturated colour the screen can show, so vivid areas keep their shading.
value: 调整全部颜色的饱和度。-100 = 灰色，+100 = 色度翻倍。接近屏幕可显示的最大饱和颜色时，增强速度减慢，使鲜艳区域仍保留明暗层次。

source: Off: the Saturation EQ group is left out of the bake (its settings stay as they are, for a quick before / after); the window's switch on the group's head.
value: 关闭时，烘焙会略过 Saturation EQ 分组，保留原设置以便快速进行前后对比。对应窗口中分组标题处的开关。

source: The shadows of the tone curve (a quarter up the scale: dark hair, shade) lighter (+) or darker (-); brightness first, the hue is kept.
value: 调整色调曲线的阴影区，即标尺约四分之一处，如深色头发和阴影。正值提亮，负值压暗，优先改变亮度并保留色相。

source: Lift: the shadows lighter (+, black rises to a dark grey, fading out towards white) or darker (-, the darks sink into black); brightness first, the hue kept, a vivid colour stops where a channel reaches white (the tone curve's rules). +-100 = a quarter of the scale at black.
value: Lift 控制阴影提亮或压暗。正值将黑色抬升为深灰，并向白色端逐渐减弱。负值使暗部沉入黑色。优先改变亮度，保留色相，鲜艳颜色在某通道达到白色时停止提亮，遵循色调曲线规则。+100 或 -100 在黑色端对应标尺四分之一。

source: Saturation of the shadows only (by lightness, with soft borders to the next zone; lit skin and bright clothes count as highlights, shaded skin as midtones): -100 = grey, +100 = twice the chroma; the push slows down near the most saturated colour the screen can show; greys never move.
value: 仅调整阴影的饱和度，按明度划分并柔和衔接相邻区域。受光皮肤和明亮衣服属于高光，阴影中的皮肤属于中间调。-100 = 灰色，+100 = 色度翻倍。接近屏幕可显示的最大饱和颜色时，增强速度减慢，灰色不变。

source: A colour added to the dark part of the picture (its hue and strength from the colour: white or grey = none); the brightness is kept, black and dark line art stay clean.
value: 给画面暗部添加的颜色，色相和强度由所选颜色决定，白色或灰色表示无染色。保留亮度，黑色和深色线稿保持干净。

source: How much of the whole Grading look is applied: 100 = all of it, 50 = half way between the untouched picture and the look, 0 = nothing (the pass stays off).
value: 整体 Grading 效果的应用比例。100 = 完整效果，50 = 原图和效果图各半，0 = 不应用，该处理通道关闭。

source: Off: the Tints group is left out of the bake (its settings stay as they are, for a quick before / after); the window's switch on the group's head.
value: 关闭时，烘焙会略过 Tints 分组，保留原设置以便快速进行前后对比。对应窗口中分组标题处的开关。

source: Off: the Tone curve group is left out of the bake (its settings stay as they are, for a quick before / after); the window's switch on the group's head.
value: 关闭时，烘焙会略过 Tone curve 分组，保留原设置以便快速进行前后对比。对应窗口中分组标题处的开关。

source: Like Saturation, but dull colours get the full change and already vivid ones little.
value: 类似 Saturation，但暗淡颜色获得完整调整，已经鲜艳的颜色只获得少量调整。

source: Split = the right half of the screen keeps the look as it was when the view went on, the left half follows the settings: tune and compare with what was (switch the view off and on to freeze again); the pass is on the camera while a setting is away from its default or a view is on. Brightness = the graded picture as its brightness only (a grey), to judge the tones without the colour; the pass stays on while this view is on. One view at a time across the modules.
value: Split 在右半屏保持开启该视图时的外观，左半屏跟随当前设置，便于调整并与之前对比。关闭再开启可重新冻结参考。任意设置偏离默认值或诊断视图开启时，相机都会运行此通道。Brightness 以灰度只显示调色后亮度，便于排除颜色干扰判断色调，该视图开启时通道持续运行。所有模块同一时间只显示一种诊断视图。

source: Saturation of the vivid colours only (HSV saturation from about two thirds: bright clothes, hair dye, pure hues): -100 = grey, +100 = twice the chroma (little room near the gamut edge: the push slows down there); greys never move.
value: 仅调整鲜艳颜色，即 HSV 饱和度约从三分之二开始，例如鲜艳衣服、染发和纯色。-100 = 灰色，+100 = 色度翻倍。色域边缘的空间较少，因此越接近边缘增强越慢。灰色不变。

source: The brightest point of the tone curve: - lowers white to a light grey (soft highlights), + pushes the brights into white; the hue is kept.
value: 色调曲线最亮端。负值将白色压为浅灰，形成柔和高光。正值将亮部推向白色，保留色相。

source: Turns the yellow colours towards the previous band's hue (-100 = that band's own hue, 30 degrees) or the next band's (+100 = 60 degrees): a band never passes its neighbour. The neighbouring bands share the change at their edges; it shrinks with the colour's chroma (pale colours get less), greys never move.
value: 使黄色向前一色带的色相偏转，-100 到达该色带的色相，偏转 30 度，或向后一色带偏转，+100 为 60 度。色带不会越过相邻色带，边缘处由相邻色带共同分担变化。变化随色度减弱，浅淡颜色受影响较少，灰色不变。

source: The yellow colours lighter (+, towards white) or darker (-).
value: 使黄色变亮（正值，趋向白色）或变暗（负值）。

source: The yellow colours more or less saturated: -100 = grey (pale colours get less of the change), +100 = twice the chroma; the push slows down near the most saturated colour the screen can show.
value: 调整黄色的饱和度。-100 = 灰色，浅淡颜色变化较少。+100 = 色度翻倍。接近屏幕可显示的最大饱和颜色时，增强速度减慢。

source: Radial distortion: above 0 barrel (the edges bow outward), below 0 pincushion; 1 = a strong fisheye-like barrel. The division model's K1 = -0.5 x this.
value: 径向畸变。大于 0 为桶形，边缘向外弯曲。小于 0 为枕形。1 为强烈的近似鱼眼桶形畸变。除法模型中的 K1 = -0.5 x 此值。

source: What shows where the lens looks outside the frame: Black (the edge of the lens's image circle) or Mirror (the picture folded back). For the aberration's taps too, with Distortion off as well.
value: 镜头采样超出画面时的显示方式。Black 显示镜头像圈边缘的黑色，Mirror 将画面镜像折回。也作用于色差采样，即使 Distortion 关闭。

source: The lens axis, as a fraction of the frame width from the middle: the distortion and the aberration grow from it; the vignette has its own centre (Vignette offset X / Y) and does not follow.
value: 镜头光轴相对画面中心的水平偏移，以画面宽度比例表示。畸变和色差从此轴向外增加。暗角使用自己的中心 Vignette offset X / Y，不随它移动。

source: The lens axis, as a fraction of the frame height from the middle.
value: 镜头光轴相对画面中心的垂直偏移，以画面高度比例表示。

source: The chromatic aberration block's switch: off = no fringe, the keys below kept.
value: 色差模块开关。关闭时没有彩边，下方参数保留。

source: What the vignette darkens towards (black = plain darkening; a colour tints the edges).
value: 暗角趋向的颜色。黑色表示单纯压暗，其他颜色会给边缘染色。

source: On: the source copy carries mips and every tap reads the level of its footprint, so a corner compressed by a strong barrel is filtered (no moire on hair and outlines). Off: one bilinear tap. For the aberration's taps too, with Distortion off as well.
value: 开启时，源图副本包含 mip 层，每次采样按覆盖范围选择层级，对强桶形畸变压缩的角落进行滤波，避免头发和轮廓产生摩尔纹。关闭时只做一次双线性采样。也作用于色差采样，即使 Distortion 关闭。

source: The edge term (K2 = -0.5 x this): acts near the corners only; a sign opposite to Barrel gives mustache distortion (barrel in the middle, pincushion at the edges).
value: 边缘项，K2 = -0.5 x 此值，只作用于角落附近。符号与 Barrel 相反时产生波浪形畸变，即中间桶形、边缘枕形。

source: The distortion block's switch: off = no distortion, the keys below kept.
value: 畸变模块开关。关闭时不产生畸变，下方参数保留。

source: On: the frame is scaled so no edge or corner shows the border, for every colour's taps (solved for the distortion, the fringe and the centre; no scaling at no distortion; a Fringe amount alone zooms in a little). Off: scale 1, a barrel shows its border at the corners and a dispersion at the edges. Acts on the aberration's taps too, with Distortion off as well.
value: 开启时缩放画面，确保所有颜色采样在边缘和角落都不露出边界。计算考虑畸变、色散及中心位置。无畸变时不缩放，仅有 Fringe amount 时也会略微放大。关闭时缩放为 1，桶形畸变会在角落露边，色散会在边缘露边。也作用于色差采样，即使 Distortion 关闭。

source: On (the default: the vignette then matches the camera): the lens width comes from the studio camera's own FOV, so a zoom changes the vignette as it does on a real camera. Off: the Width key.
value: 默认开启，使暗角与相机匹配。镜头宽度取自工作室相机自身 FOV，因此变焦会像真实相机一样改变暗角。关闭时使用 Width 参数。

source: Lateral chromatic aberration: every wavelength distorts by its own amount, so the colours of an edge land apart, more towards the corners; 1 = the red and blue sources 10 % of the half-diagonal apart at the corner. Positive: red outside a bright edge (a simple lens's lateral colour); negative: blue outside. 0 = off.
value: 横向色差。每个波长的畸变量不同，使边缘各颜色落点分离，越靠近角落越明显。1 表示角落红、蓝源采样相距画面对角线一半的 10%。正值使亮边外侧出现红色，类似简单镜头的横向色差。负值使外侧为蓝色。0 = 关闭。

source: The mechanical vignette (a hood, a barrel, a matte): a hard radius with a soft band, black beyond. 0 off, 1 full.
value: 机械暗角，类似遮光罩、镜筒或遮幅板，具有硬半径和柔和过渡带，外侧为黑色。0 = 关闭，1 = 完整效果。

source: The natural vignette (cos^4 of the field angle, the law of every lens): 0 off, 1 the full law for the chosen lens width.
value: 自然暗角，遵循所有镜头的视场角 cos^4 定律。0 = 关闭，1 = 按所选镜头宽度完整应用定律。

source: Where the band ends (0 centre, 1 the corner): beyond it the mechanical vignette is full.
value: 过渡带结束的位置，0 为中心、1 为角落。超过此处时机械暗角达到最大。

source: The band's shape: 1 round (a superellipse exponent of 2), 0 a rounded box (a superellipse exponent of 16).
value: 过渡带形状。1 为圆形，超椭圆指数为 2。0 为圆角方框，超椭圆指数为 16。

source: Circle: round in pixels, as a hood is (a box at Roundness 0 is a square). Frame: follows the frame's proportions (an ellipse, a rounded 16:9 box at Roundness 0, like a matte).
value: Circle 按像素形成圆形，类似遮光罩，Roundness 为 0 时形成正方形。Frame 跟随画面比例，形成椭圆，Roundness 为 0 时类似圆角 16:9 遮幅框。

source: The band's width as a fraction of Radius: 0 a hard edge, 1 a band from the centre to Radius.
value: 过渡带宽度，占 Radius 的比例。0 为硬边，1 为从中心到 Radius 的过渡带。

source: The radius (0 centre, 1 corner) inside which there is no fringe; the fringe grows from there to the corner. 0 = it grows from the centre.
value: 此半径以内不产生彩边，0 为中心、1 为角落。彩边从该处向角落逐渐增强。0 表示从中心开始增强。

source: Spectral: many taps along the red..blue path with triangular red / green / blue weights, the count from the spread (a smooth rainbow fringe). Channels: three taps, one per channel (a cheaper, harder split into red, green and blue).
value: Spectral 沿红到蓝路径进行多次采样，采用三角形红／绿／蓝权重，采样数由扩散范围决定，形成平滑彩虹边。Channels 每通道采样一次，共三次，速度较快，红绿蓝分离更硬。

source: Grid draws a 16 x 16 grid with a centre cross instead of the frame, through the distortion (straight lines show what the lens does); Vignette draws the vignette alone on a white frame (what it darkens and where). One view at a time across the modules.
value: Grid 用带中心十字的 16 x 16 网格替代画面，并让它经过畸变，直线可显示镜头的作用。Vignette 在白色画面上仅显示暗角，查看压暗的位置与强度。所有模块同一时间只显示一种诊断视图。

source: The vignette's centre, as a fraction of the frame width from the frame's middle (its own position: the lens axis, Centre X / Y, does not move it). Placed on the picture before the lens bends it.
value: 暗角中心相对画面中点的水平偏移，以画面宽度比例表示。它有独立位置，不受镜头光轴 Centre X / Y 影响。在镜头使画面弯曲之前定位。

source: The vignette's centre, as a fraction of the frame height from the frame's middle.
value: 暗角中心相对画面中点的垂直偏移，以画面高度比例表示。

source: The vignette block's switch: off = neither vignette, the keys kept.
value: 暗角模块开关。关闭时两种暗角都停用，参数保留。

source: Which vignette the lens draws: Natural = the light falling off towards the corners (cos^4 of the field angle); Mechanical = the shadow of the lens barrel, a soft shape; Both = the two together. The window shows the rows of the chosen type.
value: 镜头使用的暗角类型。Natural 是光线向角落衰减，遵循视场角的 cos^4。Mechanical 是镜筒形成的柔和阴影形状。Both 同时使用两者。窗口只显示所选类型的参数。

source: How wide a lens the law is computed for: the tangent of the corner's field angle (1 = a 90 degree diagonal field: the corners at 1/4 of the centre's light; 0.5 = a longer lens, 2 = an ultra-wide). Ignored with Follow FOV on.
value: 计算定律所用的镜头宽度，即角落视场角的正切。1 对应 90 度对角视场，角落亮度为中心的 1/4。0.5 类似更长焦镜头，2 类似超广角。开启 Follow FOV 时忽略此项。

source: A zoom on top of the fit: above 1 zooms in (crops the frame), below 1 zooms out (shows more of the source: the border may appear).
value: 在自动适配基础上继续缩放。大于 1 放大并裁切画面，小于 1 缩小、显示更多源图，可能露出边界。

source: On: what LUT A makes of pure black is pulled back to black and of pure white back to white (film LUTs lift the black and turn line art grey; this undoes that, per channel).
value: 开启时，将 LUT A 对纯黑的输出逐通道拉回黑色，对纯白的输出拉回白色。胶片 LUT 常会抬升黑色并让线稿变灰，此项可抵消这种变化。

source: On: what LUT B makes of pure black is pulled back to black and of pure white back to white (film LUTs lift the black and turn line art grey; this undoes that, per channel).
value: 开启时，将 LUT B 对纯黑的输出逐通道拉回黑色，对纯白的输出拉回白色。胶片 LUT 常会抬升黑色并让线稿变灰，此项可抵消这种变化。

source: How much of the colour change of LUT A is kept: 0 = none (the LUT changes lightness only), 1 = all.
value: 保留 LUT A 颜色变化的比例。0 = 不保留，LUT 只改变明度。1 = 全部保留。

source: How much of the colour change of LUT B is kept: 0 = none (the LUT changes lightness only), 1 = all.
value: 保留 LUT B 颜色变化的比例。0 = 不保留，LUT 只改变明度。1 = 全部保留。

source: LUT A: none; Shade / Shade 2 (the studio's current filters); the name of any filter of the studio's list; a .cube or PNG strip / atlas of UserData/YuppiEffects/lut (name.png#2 = row 2 of an atlas).
value: LUT A 可选 none、工作室当前滤镜 Shade / Shade 2、工作室滤镜列表中的任意名称，或 UserData/YuppiEffects/lut 中的 .cube、PNG 条带／图集。name.png#2 表示图集第 2 行。

source: LUT B: none; Shade / Shade 2 (the studio's current filters); the name of any filter of the studio's list; a .cube or PNG strip / atlas of UserData/YuppiEffects/lut (name.png#2 = row 2 of an atlas).
value: LUT B 可选 none、工作室当前滤镜 Shade / Shade 2、工作室滤镜列表中的任意名称，或 UserData/YuppiEffects/lut 中的 .cube、PNG 条带／图集。name.png#2 表示图集第 2 行。

source: How much of the lightness change of LUT A is kept: 0 = none (the LUT changes colour only), 1 = all.
value: 保留 LUT A 明度变化的比例。0 = 不保留，LUT 只改变颜色。1 = 全部保留。

source: How much of the lightness change of LUT B is kept: 0 = none (the LUT changes colour only), 1 = all.
value: 保留 LUT B 明度变化的比例。0 = 不保留，LUT 只改变颜色。1 = 全部保留。

source: How LUT A and LUT B join. B after A (default): B works on the picture A made, like a second layer - for a LUT that finishes another one (a film print, a tint over black-and-white, a weaker second look on top); the order of A and B matters, and Strength A also changes what B does. A + B: A and B each change the original picture and their changes add up; the order does not matter. That is how the studio's Blend mixes two filters, and what Copy sets for them. Two strong LUTs in A + B can burn colours: lower one. It only matters while both slots hold a LUT.
value: 决定 LUT A 与 LUT B 的组合。默认 B after A 让 B 处理 A 的结果，类似第二图层，适合用一个 LUT 完成另一个的风格，例如胶片印片、黑白画面上的染色、或叠加较弱的第二风格。A/B 顺序会影响结果，Strength A 也会改变 B 的作用。A + B 让两者各自处理原图，再叠加变化，顺序不影响结果。工作室 Blend 以此方式混合两个滤镜，Copy 也采用该模式。两个强 LUT 用 A + B 可能导致颜色过曝，可降低其中一个。仅当两槽都有 LUT 时有影响。

source: How much of LUT A: 0 = off, 1 = the full LUT, up to 2 = twice its change (pushed past the LUT).
value: LUT A 的强度。0 = 关闭，1 = 完整 LUT，最高 2 = 双倍变化，可超过 LUT 原有效果。

source: How much of LUT B: 0 = off, 1 = the full LUT, up to 2 = twice its change (pushed past the LUT).
value: LUT B 的强度。0 = 关闭，1 = 完整 LUT，最高 2 = 双倍变化，可超过 LUT 原有效果。

source: Split = the right half of the screen keeps the look as it was when the view went on, the left half follows the settings: tune and compare with what was (switch the view off and on to freeze again). One view at a time across the modules.
value: Split 在右半屏保持开启视图时的外观，左半屏跟随当前设置，便于调整并与之前对比。关闭再开启可重新冻结参考。所有模块同一时间只显示一种诊断视图。

source: Disable the studio's own Depth of Field (the scene's Depth of Field flag) on the main camera: our dof module is the one in use, the studio's would blur the frame a second time.
value: 停用主相机上工作室自身的景深，即场景的 Depth of Field 标志。当前使用本插件的 dof 模块，工作室景深会使画面再次模糊。

source: Hold the game's multisampling (MSAA) off on the main camera while this module is on. The game switches it on by its quality level unless the Graphics Settings plugin says otherwise; our effects read a depth texture that is not multisampled, so with it on their edges may not match the picture's. Off = the camera's own setting back, as it was found. The Render button's stills do not need the game's anti-aliasing: their own samples do that work.
value: 此模块开启时，持续关闭主相机的游戏多重采样 MSAA。除非 Graphics Settings 插件另有设置，游戏会按质量等级开启 MSAA。本插件效果读取未多重采样的深度纹理，MSAA 开启时可能使效果边缘与画面不匹配。关闭此项会恢复最初读取的相机设置。Render 静帧使用自身采样抗锯齿，无需游戏抗锯齿。

source: Disable the game's BloomAndFlares on the main camera (it runs after our LUT on the tonemapped frame; our own bloom (the bloom module) runs in scene-linear before the LUT).
value: 停用主相机上的游戏 BloomAndFlares，它在色调映射画面的本插件 LUT 之后运行。本插件的 bloom 模块在 LUT 前的场景线性空间运行。

source: Disable the game's VignetteAndChromaticAberration on the main camera (on in a new studio scene; it runs after our chain on the tonemapped frame and would stack with the lens module's vignette, which darkens the scene-linear frame before the LUT).
value: 停用主相机上的游戏 VignetteAndChromaticAberration。新建工作室场景默认开启它，它在色调映射画面上的本插件处理链之后运行，会与 lens 模块暗角叠加。本插件暗角在 LUT 前使场景线性画面变暗。

source: Disable the PostProcessingEffects plugin's components on the main camera (its PostProcessLayer, SSAOPro, SobelOutline, Posterize, SengaEffect) for the live picture: its AO, bloom and outline would stack with ours. The Render button switches them off for its renders whatever this says.
value: 在实时画面的主相机上停用 PostProcessingEffects 插件组件，包括 PostProcessLayer、SSAOPro、SobelOutline、Posterize、SengaEffect，避免其 AO、泛光和轮廓与本插件叠加。Render 按钮输出时，无论此项如何都会关闭它们。

source: Transparent = the still has a real alpha: the studio's background (its colour, the sky, the background picture) is removed from the camera's view only - the map and the items stay, the lights are not touched. Every sample renders the bare scene over black and over white first (so half-transparent hair and clothes keep their blend), then the colour view over black; the file is written with straight alpha. A glow over the empty area has no coverage of its own: see Glow keeps alpha. The game's own camera effects left on (its depth of field, its vignette) act on the colour only. Scene = the picture as on the screen, alpha 1.
value: Transparent 输出真实 alpha，只从相机视图移除工作室背景颜色、天空和背景图片，地图和物件保留，灯光不变。每个采样先分别在黑底和白底上渲染基础场景，以保留半透明头发和衣服的混合，再在黑底渲染颜色视图，文件使用直通 alpha。空白区域上的泛光本身没有覆盖率，见 Glow keeps alpha。仍开启的游戏相机效果，如景深和暗角，只作用于颜色。Scene 与屏幕画面一致，alpha 为 1。

source: The PNG's bits per channel: 8 (the usual file) or 16 (for grading afterwards; about three times the size and a few seconds longer to write).
value: PNG 每通道位数。8 为普通文件，16 适合后期调色，文件约为三倍大，写入多耗时几秒。

source: How the shifted renders are combined: Box = every render counts whole (the sharpest); Gaussian = a film filter of 1.5 px (a little softer, the smoothest edges).
value: 偏移渲染的合并方式。Box 将每次渲染完整计入，最锐利。Gaussian 使用 1.5 px 胶片滤波，略柔和且边缘最平滑。

source: Transparent stills: a glow over the empty area gets an alpha from its brightness, so it survives in the PNG (off = a glow over nothing is lost when the file is laid over another picture); a pixel the scene covers at all keeps its true alpha. On a dark background it looks like the glow; on a bright one a faint glow becomes a faint haze.
value: 透明静帧中，空白区域的泛光按亮度取得 alpha，以便保留在 PNG 中。关闭时，文件叠到其他图片上会丢失空白区域的泛光。只要场景对某像素存在覆盖，就保留该像素真实 alpha。在暗背景上呈现泛光，在亮背景上微弱泛光会形成薄雾感。

source: The still's Samples in one move: Light = 128, Medium = 256, High = 512 (the default), Extreme = 1024. Type a Samples value and it reads Custom (your value stays). Ambient occlusion, the lens and the glow keep one fixed quality in the still whatever this says.
value: 一键设置静帧 Samples。Light = 128，Medium = 256，默认 High = 512，Extreme = 1024。手动填写 Samples 后显示 Custom，并保留该值。无论此项如何，静帧的 AO、镜头和泛光都使用各自固定质量。

source: The renders accumulated into the still, each shifted by a fraction of a pixel (and, with the dof module on, each a lens sample too): edges, strands and highlights get smoother with more, and the render takes longer. The edges settle by about 128; the ambient occlusion's noise and a big lens blur gain beyond that; 1 = one plain render. A value typed here sets Quality to Custom.
value: 累计到静帧中的渲染次数，每次偏移不足一个像素。开启 dof 时，每次也是一个镜头采样。次数越多，边缘、发丝和高光越平滑，耗时越长。边缘约在 128 次时稳定，AO 噪声和较大镜头模糊在更多采样下仍有改善。1 = 单次普通渲染。手动填写会将 Quality 改为 Custom。

source: On: during a render the scene's textures are sampled a little finer (half a mip level, put back after the render), so the still's cloth, skin and hair textures are crisper. Its cost: fine patterns may shimmer or show moire.
value: 开启时，渲染中会让场景纹理的采样细化半个 mip 层，完成后恢复，使静帧的布料、皮肤和头发纹理更清晰。代价是细密图案可能闪烁或产生摩尔纹。

source: A sharpening pass on the finished still, contrast-adaptive: edges that are already contrasty or saturated are left alone, so no halos. 0 = off, 0.01 = the mildest, 1 = the strongest.
value: 对完成的静帧进行对比度自适应锐化。已有较高对比度或饱和度的边缘不再增强，因此不产生光晕。0 = 关闭，0.01 = 最轻，1 = 最强。

source: A size in one move: Screen = the game window's size (the default), 1080p = 1920x1080, 1440p = 2560x1440, 4K = 3840x2160; Custom = the Width and Height as typed.
value: 一键设置尺寸。默认 Screen 为游戏窗口大小，1080p = 1920x1080，1440p = 2560x1440，4K = 3840x2160，Custom 使用手动填写的 Width 和 Height。

source: The still's width in pixels (the file's size; every sample is rendered at it with a narrow band around it, 3 % of the longer side, that the file crops). The Size preset writes it (Screen = the game window's size, kept in step); a value typed here sets the preset to Custom.
value: 静帧文件的宽度，单位为像素。每次采样按此尺寸渲染，并在周围留出长边 3% 的窄边，写文件时裁掉。Size 预设会写入此值。Screen 使用并同步游戏窗口尺寸，手动输入会将预设改为 Custom。

source: Count solid ones: also the flat ones - a mesh thinner than a millimetre or of 8 vertices or fewer (a studio image plate, a 2D sprite, a shadow disc, a decal card on the skin). Off by default: such a plate is a picture, not a body; in the depth it would take the shadows of what stands in front of it and a decal card would ring itself with a dark halo. On = treat them as solid too.
value: Count solid ones 是否也计入平面物件，即厚度小于一毫米或顶点数不超过 8 的网格，例如工作室图片板、2D 精灵、阴影圆片或皮肤上的贴花卡片。默认关闭，因为这些平面通常表示图片。在深度中计入后，它会接收前方物体的阴影，皮肤贴花周围也可能出现暗晕。开启时将它们也视为实心。

source: Publish the material's base colour next to the normal (a second render target of the same draw) for the other modules: the colour the game's shader composes before any light (the colour-mask recolour of skin, clothes, hair and items; the skin's overlays; Standard's main texture x colour), with a confidence (full for a known shader family, half for main texture x colour on an unknown shader, none otherwise). Changes no picture by itself.
value: 在法线旁输出材质基础颜色，同一次绘制使用第二个渲染目标，供其他模块使用。它表示游戏着色器在任何光照之前合成的颜色，包括皮肤、服装、头发和物件的颜色遮罩换色，皮肤叠加层，以及 Standard 的主纹理乘颜色。还输出可信度，已知着色器家族为完整可信度，未知着色器的主纹理乘颜色为一半，其余为零。此功能本身不改变画面。

source: Publish the normal of everything else on a character that is in the depth texture (clothes, accessories, teeth, eyebrows): the mesh's vertex normal, kept where the surface matches the depth texture.
value: 输出角色上深度纹理中其他部位的法线，包括衣服、饰品、牙齿、眉毛。使用网格顶点法线，只保留表面与深度纹理一致的位置。

source: Off (the default) = Unity's rule alone: an object on a transparent render queue (above 2500) is a hole for every effect that reads the depth. On = such an object whose material is solid - it writes depth and is opaque enough - is drawn into the camera's depth texture, so the ambient occlusion, the focus and the other effects see it: a hair accessory moved to a late queue, a swimsuit on an alpha shader. What on can cost: a see-through pane whose material blends by a fractional opacity (a window's glass with a stained texture) is counted in patches and gets shaded where you look through it.
value: 默认关闭时仅遵循 Unity 规则，透明渲染队列（大于 2500）的物件对所有读取深度的效果都相当于空洞。开启后，这类物件若材质足够实心，即写入深度且足够不透明，会被绘入相机深度纹理，使 AO、对焦和其他效果能看到它，例如移到靠后队列的头发饰品或使用 alpha 着色器的泳装。可能的代价是以部分不透明度混合的透明平面，例如带染色纹理的窗玻璃，会被分块计入，并在透视位置产生阴影。

source: Shader names (comma separated) never published, whatever family they fall in, the body / face skin included (a material of such a shader keeps the depth normal in ao). Default: Az's invisible shadow helpers. The window shows the list read-only; edit it here.
value: 永不输出的着色器名称列表，以逗号分隔，适用于所有类别，包括身体和面部皮肤。使用这些着色器的材质在 AO 中保留深度法线。默认包含 Az 的不可见阴影辅助物。窗口只读显示此列表，可在这里编辑。

source: Publish the normal of hair (a hair shader by name, the game's hair or hair worn as an item): the card's vertex normal, kept where the surface matches the depth texture. Off = hair keeps the depth normal in ao.
value: 输出头发法线，按着色器名称识别，包括游戏头发和作为物件佩戴的头发。使用发片顶点法线，只保留与深度纹理匹配的表面。关闭时，AO 中头发继续使用深度法线。

source: Publish the normal of studio items and the map (every renderer outside the characters that is in the depth texture): the mesh's vertex normal. Hundreds of draws in a full room; see the frame time.
value: 输出工作室物件和地图的法线，即角色以外所有出现在深度纹理中的渲染器，使用网格顶点法线。完整房间可能需要数百次绘制，请关注帧耗时。

source: AO's Geometry method: parts of renderer names (comma separated) whose objects are captured and drawn as before but do NOT occlude ambient-occlusion rays - for an overlay that lies on the skin as a sheet (the Goo Nipples accessory by default: its soft rim would shade the skin under it into a dark ring). The general rule needs no list: a renderer whose Cast Shadows is off in the game (a translucent swimsuit, eyebrows, eye lines, teeth) already casts no ambient shadow; this list adds objects by name whatever their flag. ao's Casters = All ignores both. Takes effect at the next capture.
value: AO 的 Geometry 方法中，按渲染器名称片段排除遮蔽投射，以逗号分隔。这些对象仍被捕获和绘制，但不遮挡 AO 射线，适用于贴在皮肤上的薄片叠加层。默认排除 Goo Nipples 饰品，避免柔边在皮肤上形成暗环。一般规则无需列名，游戏中关闭 Cast Shadows 的渲染器，如半透明泳装、眉毛、眼线、牙齿，本来就不投射环境阴影。此列表额外按名称排除对象，不受其标志影响。AO 的 Casters = All 会忽略这两种排除。下次捕获时生效。

source: Clothes, hair and items: apply the material's own normal map (_NormalMap, scale and tiling as the game) on top of the vertex normal, so seams, stitches and the weave of the cloth reach the occlusion where the material has a map. Off = the smooth vertex normal only.
value: 对衣服、头发和物件，在顶点法线上叠加材质自身法线贴图 _NormalMap，使用与游戏一致的缩放和平铺，使接缝、针脚和布料织纹参与遮蔽。关闭时仅使用平滑顶点法线。

source: Count solid ones: the opacity a material needs to count as solid - a V+ alpha shader's AlphaValue, Standard's colour alpha; an opaque shader is 1. Below it the object is left alone (a translucent image plate or a glasses lens at 0.67 neither cuts the depth nor takes ao); above it the object is solid and its pixels take the whole ao. 0.9 by default, so that a lens at 0.67 does not take the eyes' depth. The fractional alpha shaders that write depth - Az ClothAlpha / LiteAlpha / ItemAlpha / EyeW, xukmi MainAlphaPlus / MainItemAlphaPlus / MainItemStudioAlphaPlus / HairFrontPlus (and their Tess forms) - count as solid whatever this value says; it decides for the shaders with a plain opacity value (Standard-like ones, an opaque V+ shader moved to a late queue). An Az alpha shader's depth is drawn without its dither, so the depth, the normal and the base colour cover its whole footprint.
value: Count solid ones 使用的不透明度门槛。V+ alpha 着色器取 AlphaValue，Standard 取颜色 alpha，不透明着色器视为 1。低于门槛时不处理物件，例如不透明度 0.67 的透明图片板或眼镜片既不切断深度，也不接受 AO。高于门槛时视为实心，像素接受完整 AO。默认 0.9，避免 0.67 的镜片占用眼睛深度。会写入深度的部分 alpha 着色器始终视为实心，包括 Az ClothAlpha / LiteAlpha / ItemAlpha / EyeW，以及 xukmi MainAlphaPlus / MainItemAlphaPlus / MainItemStudioAlphaPlus / HairFrontPlus 及其 Tess 版本。此门槛用于具有普通不透明度值的着色器，如 Standard 类或移到靠后队列的不透明 V+。Az alpha 着色器的深度绘制不使用抖动，因此深度、法线和基础颜色覆盖整个物件投影。

source: In millimetres: vertices whose rest positions are this close (mesh units read as metres; 0.001 mm = 1e-6) are one point of the surface: UV-seam twins share one ring of neighbours and one normal. 0 = only bit-equal positions. A change rebuilds the per-mesh data.
value: 以毫米表示的顶点合并距离。静止位置如此接近的顶点视为同一个表面点，网格单位按米解释，0.001 mm = 1e-6。UV 接缝处重合顶点共享一圈邻接顶点和同一法线。0 = 仅合并逐位完全相同的位置。修改后重建各网格数据。

source: Publish the skin's shape normal: the character's body and face (the renderers o_body_a / cf_O_face, whatever shader they wear). Off = the skin keeps the depth normal in ao.
value: 输出皮肤的形状法线，作用于角色身体和面部渲染器 o_body_a / cf_O_face，不受其使用的着色器影响。关闭时，AO 中皮肤继续使用深度法线。

source: Information, written by the module (not a setting): every shader whose tessellated shadow caster the publish reproduces (tessellated: the Tess shaders of Vanilla Plus; tessellated by property: the Az Standard shaders, whose Tessellation / Displacement are material toggles; tessellated by keyword: Az StandardCutoff / StandardAlpha / StandardAlphaAlt), with the count of its slots in the scene when the last scan found any, and then every other shader with Tess in its name that the scan found, published with the flat mesh (flat: its silhouettes and folds may lose pixels).
value: 模块写入的信息字段，不是设置。列出输出时复现了曲面细分阴影投射的着色器，以及上次扫描发现时在场景中的材质槽数量。包括 Vanilla Plus 的 Tess 着色器，通过材质开关 Tessellation / Displacement 启用细分的 Az Standard，以及通过关键词启用的 Az StandardCutoff / StandardAlpha / StandardAlphaAlt。之后列出其他名称包含 Tess、但以平面网格输出的着色器，这些平面替代可能丢失轮廓和褶皱像素。

source: A plain picture over everything: Normal = the published normal as a colour (black where nothing is published); Weight = white where this module published a normal, black where it did not (ao keeps the depth normal there): holes and coverage at a glance; Albedo (with Base colour on) = the published base colour as it is; Groups = a colour per group of objects over the frame (skin, clothes, hair, items; darkened where nothing is published); Transparent = the objects on a transparent queue that count as solid, the 2D images among them in their own colour, and the flat ones left out in a third; AoShadow = who casts an ambient shadow in ao's Geometry method and who does not (the game's Cast Shadows off, or named by No AO shadow). One view at a time across the modules.
value: 覆盖在全部内容之上的诊断画面。Normal 将输出法线显示为颜色，未输出位置为黑色。Weight 用白色表示已输出法线，黑色表示未输出，AO 在黑色处保留深度法线，可快速查看空洞和覆盖率。开启 Base colour 时，Albedo 显示输出的基础颜色。Groups 在画面上按皮肤、服装、头发和物件分组着色，未输出位置压暗。Transparent 显示透明队列中计为实心的对象，其中 2D 图像用独立颜色，被排除的平面用第三种颜色。AoShadow 显示 Geometry AO 中哪些对象投射环境阴影、哪些因 Cast Shadows 关闭或 No AO shadow 名单而不投射。所有模块同一时间只显示一种诊断视图。

source: Exposure in stops (frame x 2^EV), after the white balance, before the game's own image effects. 0 = no change.
value: 曝光挡数，画面乘以 2^EV，位于白平衡之后、游戏自身图像效果之前。0 = 不改变。

source: White balance: the colour temperature (kelvin) of the light the picture is balanced for, applied to the linear frame before the game's own image effects. Lower = a cooler (bluer) picture, higher = warmer. 6500 with Tint 0 = daylight = no change.
value: 白平衡，画面要针对的光源色温，单位为开尔文，在游戏自身图像效果前作用于线性画面。数值越低画面越冷、越蓝，越高越暖。6500 且 Tint 为 0 表示日光，不改变画面。

source: White balance: the green / magenta offset of that white. + = a more magenta picture, - = greener. 0 with Temperature 6500 = daylight = no change (3000 = one step of the CIE 1960 uv chart away from the daylight white).
value: 白平衡的绿／品红偏移。正值使画面更品红，负值更绿。0 且 Temperature 为 6500 表示日光，不改变画面。3000 表示在 CIE 1960 uv 色度图中距日光白点一个单位步长。

source: Split = the right half of the screen keeps the look as it was when the view went on, the left half follows the settings: tune and compare with what was (switch the view off and on to freeze again). Clipping = red where the picture is at or above white in some channel, blue where it is black in every channel, the rest as is. One view at a time across the modules.
value: Split 在右半屏保持开启视图时的外观，左半屏跟随当前设置，便于调整对比。关闭再开启可重新冻结参考。Clipping 在任意通道达到或超过白色的位置显示红色，所有通道均为黑色的位置显示蓝色，其余保持原图。所有模块同一时间只显示一种诊断视图。

source: On (default): a studio scene that carries this plugin's settings (every scene saved with the plugin does) sets them when it is loaded; the preset list then has the entry Scene. Off: scenes open with the settings as they stand; the entry Scene still applies them by hand. A scene without such settings changes nothing, and neither does an import of a scene's items. Never part of a preset.
value: 默认开启。载入携带本插件设置的工作室场景时应用其设置，所有启用插件后保存的场景都携带设置，此时预设列表出现 Scene。关闭时沿用当前设置载入场景，仍可手动点击 Scene 应用场景设置。没有本插件设置的场景，以及只导入场景物件，都不会改变当前设置。不保存到预设。

source: Groups folded in the settings card, as module/group tokens separated by ';'. Never part of a preset.
value: 设置卡片中折叠的分组，以分号分隔 module/group 标记。不保存到预设。

source: Starred items of the list settings, kept at the top of their list: module/key=name|name tokens separated by ';'. Never part of a preset.
value: 列表设置中已加星的条目会置顶。格式为 module/key=name|name，各组以分号分隔。不保存到预设。

source: Set to true (in the settings list) to switch the plugin on and open the window; it falls back to false by itself.
value: 在设置列表中设为 true，可启用插件并打开窗口，随后会自动恢复为 false。

source: On, a module's card opens its View block with it (the scopes of the frame, the module's picture views and their rows) and the View follows the card to another module; off, the View opens only by its pill and closes when another module's card opens. The switch is the first row of the window's Settings card (the gear). Never part of a preset.
value: 开启时，模块卡片同时展开其 View 区块，包括画面示波器、模块诊断视图及参数，切换模块时 View 也跟随。关闭时，View 只通过胶囊按钮展开，打开其他模块卡片时关闭。此开关位于齿轮 Settings 卡片的第一行。不保存到预设。

source: The preset shown in the header: a file name of UserData/YuppiEffects/presets or Default. Never part of a preset.
value: 标题中显示的预设，为 UserData/YuppiEffects/presets 中的文件名或 Default。不保存到预设。

source: The Preview switch, the first row of the module list: on, the modules that can build a better picture while the camera stands do it by themselves (dof's lens blur; ao's Geometry occlusion with Method = Geometry while dof has nothing to show), a camera move or a setting shows the live picture and the preview builds again; a view of another module pauses it. Off at every studio start and after a scene's load. Never part of a preset.
value: 模块列表第一行的 Preview 开关。开启后，可在相机静止时改善画面的模块会自动累计结果，包括 dof 镜头模糊，以及 Method = Geometry 且 dof 没有可显示内容时的 Geometry AO。移动相机或改变设置时显示实时画面，然后重新累计预览。其他模块诊断视图会暂停它。每次工作室启动和场景载入后关闭。不保存到预设。

source: On, the Render button's still keeps the module view that is on (AO's Occlusion, Surface's Normal, any module's): the file is that view's picture. Off (the default), the render puts the view off at its start and back at its end - a still always shows the picture itself. The switch is the fourth row of the window's Settings card (the gear). Never part of a preset.
value: 开启时，Render 静帧保留当前模块诊断视图，例如 AO 的 Occlusion、Surface 的 Normal 或其他模块视图，文件将输出该视图画面。默认关闭时，渲染开始先关闭诊断视图，结束后恢复，静帧始终显示实际画面。此开关位于齿轮 Settings 卡片的第四行。不保存到预设。

source: On, the scopes' screen of the View block is unfolded whenever the block opens; off, it stays as it was left, folded at the window's start. The switch is the second row of the window's Settings card (the gear). Never part of a preset.
value: 开启时，每次打开 View 区块都会展开示波器画面。关闭时保留上次折叠状态，窗口初次打开时折叠。此开关位于齿轮 Settings 卡片的第二行。不保存到预设。

source: Where the window was left (reference pixels from the centre). Never part of a preset.
value: 窗口上次位置，以相对屏幕中心的参考像素表示。不保存到预设。

source: Ambient occlusion on the HDR frame before bloom and the tone map, applied to opaques before the transparents: screen-space on the screen (a visibility bitmask or a horizon method, the radius in metres through the exact projection, a guided filter) and, with Method = Geometry, ray-traced over the scene's own triangles for the Render button's renders and, with the window's Preview switch on, on screen while the camera stands; takes the studio's own Amplify Occlusion off while on. Off = as if the module never existed. Applies at once.
value: 在泛光和色调映射之前，对 HDR 画面应用环境遮蔽，在透明物体绘制前作用于不透明物体。屏幕使用可见性位掩码或地平线方法，半径以米表示，通过精确投影换算，并带引导滤波。Method = Geometry 时，Render 对场景真实三角形进行光线追踪。窗口 Preview 开启且相机静止时，屏幕也可显示该结果。开启时会关闭工作室自身 Amplify Occlusion。关闭后等同于模块不存在，立即生效。

source: A glow around the bright parts of the HDR frame, before the colour LUT: a soft threshold on the brightest channel picks what glows, a pyramid of ever wider blurs spreads it, and the levels are summed back over the frame, so lamps and highlights bleed light into their surroundings. Off = as if the module never existed. Applies at once.
value: 在颜色 LUT 之前，对 HDR 画面亮部产生泛光。按最亮通道应用软阈值选择发光区域，用逐渐加宽的模糊金字塔扩散，再将各层叠回画面，使灯光和高光向周围溢出光线。关闭后等同于模块不存在，立即生效。

source: Depth of field for the Render button: the frozen scene is rendered many more times from points of the lens aperture, each view aimed so the focus plane stays put, and the frames are averaged, so whatever is off the focus plane blurs with a real bokeh, hair, alpha and the drawn eyes included (no screen-space guessing). The focus from a point on the screen (the Point 1 button, then a click; its own depth, offset and tilt), a distance or the camera's orbit pivot; the strength as one slider. Point 2 adds a second sharp object in any mode (focus stacking): a render per plane, every view split by its own depth into the two planes' layers, the nearer layer composited over the farther one. The live picture changes only with the window's Preview switch (the same accumulation at the screen size while the camera stands still), the focus map or the peaking view, and the points' crosshairs. Off = as if the module never existed. Applies at once.
value: Render 按钮的景深。冻结场景，从镜头光圈上的多个点反复渲染，每个视角都瞄准同一焦平面，再对画面求平均。因此焦平面外的内容形成真实散景，包括头发、alpha 和绘制出的眼睛，不采用屏幕空间估算。焦点可取屏幕点，点击 Point 1 后在画面设置，并有独立深度、偏移和倾斜，也可使用距离或相机环绕中心，强度由一个滑块控制。Point 2 可在任意模式增加第二个清晰物件，形成焦点堆栈。每平面单独渲染，各视角按自身深度分成两平面图层，近层合成到远层之上。实时画面仅在 Preview 开关、Focus map、Peaking 视图或对焦十字线开启时变化。Preview 在相机静止时按屏幕尺寸做相同累计。关闭后等同于模块不存在，立即生效。

source: A parametric grading layer after lut, baked into one 33^3 LUT when a setting changes: exposure, colour-preserving contrast, saturation and vibrance with a soft stop at the gamut edge, density, a colour filter, shadow / highlight tints, bleach bypass, eight HSL colour bands, a highlight hue roll-off, a five-point tone curve, saturation per lightness zone, a midtones tint, a strength, a bypass per group, lift / gamma / gain per zone, saturation by saturation, a point curve per channel. Off = as if the module never existed. Applies at once.
value: LUT 之后的参数化调色层，设置改变时烘焙为一个 33^3 LUT。包含曝光、保色对比度、在色域边缘柔和停止的饱和度和鲜艳度、密度、滤色、阴影／高光染色、漂白旁路、八段 HSL、亮部色相滚降、五点色调曲线、按明度区间的饱和度、中间调染色、整体强度、逐组旁路、分区 lift / gamma / gain、按饱和度分区的饱和度，以及逐通道点曲线。关闭后等同于模块不存在，立即生效。

source: Lens distortion (barrel / pincushion and an edge term, fitted so no corner goes black, the squeezed corners filtered), lateral chromatic aberration (a colour fringe along each wavelength's own distortion) and the vignette (the natural fall-off of light towards the corners and a mechanical one with a soft band, both around their own centre, free of the lens axis) in one pass on the HDR frame after bloom, before the colour LUT. Each effect has its own switch; at the defaults nothing changes and the pass is off. Off = as if the module never existed. Applies at once.
value: 在泛光之后、颜色 LUT 之前，对 HDR 画面一次处理镜头畸变、横向色差和暗角。畸变包括桶形／枕形和边缘项，自动适配以避免角落变黑，并滤波压缩的角落。色差沿每个波长自身畸变形成彩边。暗角包括向角落的自然光线衰减和带柔和过渡的机械暗角，两者共享独立中心，不依赖镜头光轴。各效果有独立开关，默认参数不改变画面，处理通道关闭。关闭后等同于模块不存在，立即生效。

source: A second LUT after the tone map, replacing the studio's Color Adjustment while a slot is set: two slots (the studio's Shade filters, any filter of the studio's list, .cube and PNG files of UserData/YuppiEffects/lut), each with a strength; the card's `Mode` says how they join: B works on A's result (B after A, the default) or both work on the original and their changes add up (A + B); the card's Copy pill carries the studio's Shade / Shade 2 / Blend into the slots. Off = as if the module never existed. Applies at once.
value: 色调映射之后的第二层 LUT，在任意槽已设置时替代工作室 Color Adjustment。两个槽可使用工作室 Shade 滤镜、列表中的其他滤镜，以及 UserData/YuppiEffects/lut 的 .cube 和 PNG 文件，各有独立强度。卡片 Mode 决定组合方式，默认 B after A 让 B 处理 A 的结果，A + B 让两者处理原图并叠加变化。Copy 胶囊按钮将工作室 Shade / Shade 2 / Blend 复制到槽内。关闭后等同于模块不存在，立即生效。

source: Keeps the game's own camera effects from stacking with ours while the plugin is on: five switches of the Settings card, all on by default, switch off the game's bloom, its vignette, the studio's own Depth of Field, the game's multisampling on the main camera and the PostProcessingEffects plugin's components. The studio's Color Adjustment (AmplifyColor) is not touched here: the LUT module alone switches it off, while it is on with a table in a slot. No row in the module list: it runs whenever the plugin is on. Off = as if the module never existed. Applies at once.
value: 插件开启时避免游戏相机效果与本插件叠加。Settings 卡片的五个开关默认全开，分别关闭游戏泛光、游戏暗角、工作室自身景深、主相机 MSAA，以及 PostProcessingEffects 插件组件。工作室 Color Adjustment（AmplifyColor）由 LUT 模块单独控制，仅当 LUT 模块开启且槽内有表时关闭。此模块不在模块列表中显示，只要插件开启就运行。关闭后等同于模块不存在，立即生效。

source: The Render button's still: N renders of the paused scene, each shifted by a fraction of a pixel (with the dof module on, each is a lens sample too), summed after the whole effect chain and combined with a Box or a Gaussian 1.5 px film filter, then written as an 8- or 16-bit PNG into Screencap's folder as YuppiEffects-<date>-s<N>-<filter>-<bits>.png, with the settings in the file's text. Size: Screen (the game window's size), 1080p, 1440p, 4K or Custom (Width x Height as typed); Quality sets the Samples in one move (Light 128, Medium 256, High 512, Extreme 1024). Off = as if the module never existed. Applies at once.
value: Render 按钮输出静帧。对暂停的场景进行 N 次渲染，每次偏移不足一个像素，开启 dof 时也同时进行镜头采样。在完整效果链之后累计，以 Box 或 Gaussian 1.5 px 胶片滤波合并，再以 8 或 16 位 PNG 写入 Screencap 文件夹，文件名为 YuppiEffects-<date>-s<N>-<filter>-<bits>.png，设置保存在文件文本中。Size 可选 Screen（游戏窗口尺寸）、1080p、1440p、4K 或 Custom（手动 Width x Height）。Quality 一键设置 Samples，Light 128、Medium 256、High 512、Extreme 1024。关闭后等同于模块不存在，立即生效。

source: Gives the other modules the surfaces of the frame: a shading normal per pixel and, with Base colour on, the material's base colour. The skin of the body and face gets its shape normal carried through the pose, whatever shader it wears; clothes, hair and items get their mesh's normal where the surface matches the depth texture, with the material's normal map on top. Changes no picture by itself. Off = as if the module never existed. Applies at once.
value: 向其他模块提供画面表面信息，包括逐像素着色法线，以及开启 Base colour 时的材质基础颜色。身体和面部皮肤使用随姿势变形的形状法线，与着色器无关。服装、头发和物件在表面匹配深度纹理的位置使用网格法线，并叠加材质法线贴图。此功能自身不改变画面。关闭后等同于模块不存在，立即生效。

source: White balance (Temperature / Tint) and exposure of the HDR frame before the game's own image effects; no tone curve is applied: apart from them the frame passes on as the game made it. Off = as if the module never existed. Applies at once.
value: 在游戏自身图像效果之前，对 HDR 画面应用白平衡 Temperature / Tint 和曝光，不应用色调曲线，除这两项外按游戏原始结果传递画面。关闭后等同于模块不存在，立即生效。

source: The in-game settings window (CharaStudio toolbar button): the module list with switches, the selected module's card in groups, the extra block (colour, LUT library, presets) and the View block (the scopes of the frame and the modules' picture views). Its toolbar button switches the whole plugin on and off. Off = as if the module never existed. Applies at once.
value: 游戏内设置窗口，通过 CharaStudio 工具栏按钮打开。包含模块列表和开关、所选模块按组排列的卡片、颜色／LUT 库／预设扩展区块，以及画面示波器和模块诊断视图组成的 View 区块。工具栏按钮开关整个插件。关闭后等同于模块不存在，立即生效。
